common: One original naturalistic live-action photograph for a grounded Shanghai story game, at the same modest Xinzhuang dumpling stall as the reference, at real blue-hour dusk under ordinary warm kitchen light. Real documentary lens, original visual composition, believable material wear and anatomy, no text, brand, logos, color grading gimmick, CGI, drawing, beautiful product staging, big steam cloud, fire, or fake writing.

items.hero: Vertical 2:3 shop portrait at half-body distance. The same middle-aged fictional man Wu, his familiar round face, slightly thinning hair and charcoal rolled sleeves and worn dark apron. He stands in the half-open shop, getting the first pan ready with one hand resting on the iron lid, turns to face the person who just arrived with a calm knowing smile. His face near upper center, his gesture and eye contact clear. In the foreground actual round Shanghai shengjian buns on a plain metal plate, no other type of pastry. The sidewalk and two waiting neighbors in real bokeh behind. Keep the lower quarter as a naturally darker matte area of the counter that can host title later, no text now. Candid, honest light and skin.
items.receipt-clean: Landscape 3:2 tabletop still of a tiny real Shanghai shop. One plate of well browned round Shanghai shengjian, with black sesame and a little chive, and an open paper takeout packet with a few toasted crescent guotie beside it, a metal order clip and three nearly blank narrow order slips on a steel counter. Off to the edge, the tired chef's charcoal sleeve and a hand stacking a final slip. Closing time tungsten light and a background window out of focus. Film still, no commercial food arrangement.
items.receipt-rush: Landscape 3:2 close countertop still as service ends. Two last singed (dark golden but believable) Shanghai round shengjian on a little plate with a tiny dark crispy edge, a wiped but scratched black iron griddle and two crumpled blank-looking ticket slips on the counter. Soft light from the old shop's ordinary lamp. One worn kitchen cloth, some dark blue beyond the window, quiet after the busy rush. No highly charred toxic looking food, no logos, no fire.
